network.headline: Couldn't reach the provisioning service
network.body: The request to Sanity or Vercel timed out or the connection dropped before finishing. This is often temporary.

unknown.headline: This step failed
unknown.body: Provisioning hit an error that isn't recognized yet. The technical details below may help diagnose it.
unknown.nextStep: Retry, or check the technical details before asking for help.

permission.headline: Missing permission to complete this step
permission.body: The teardown credentials aren't allowed to do what this step needs — often revoking a token or removing a project member. It may need to be finished manually in the Sanity Manage or Vercel dashboard.
permission.nextStep: Grant the missing permission, then re-dispatch teardown.

duplicate.headline: Already in use elsewhere
duplicate.body: Something this step is trying to remove or reassign — a domain mapping, a token — is already claimed or referenced elsewhere.
duplicate.nextStep: Resolve the conflict, then re-dispatch teardown.

network.headline: Couldn't reach the teardown service
network.body: The request to Sanity or Vercel timed out or the connection dropped before finishing. This is often temporary.
network.nextStep: Wait a moment, then re-dispatch teardown.

unknown.headline: This step failed
unknown.body: Teardown hit an error that isn't recognized yet. The technical details below may help diagnose it.
unknown.nextStep: Re-dispatch teardown, or check the technical details before asking for help.
